page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs derived from 6 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and relies on a KVM hypervisor. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%. Database operations, such as Redis SET operations, maintain average throughput.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is its modest single-threaded execution speed contrasted against its generous memory allocation. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance provides a dense memory footprint without the added expense of high-frequency compute cores or local NVMe storage. It is best suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require extreme single-core processing power, such as medium-sized databases, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
